label: Enable server access
help: Text is sent only when this option is enabled and the text input executes. No request during Run preparation.

label: Self-hosted server root URL
help: Your SGLang-Omni Higgs server, without /v1/audio/speech. HTTPS required except numeric loopback HTTP; no redirects or implicit proxy.

label: Server token wallet reference (optional)
help: Only the secret reference, never its value. Empty means no authentication. The token is sent solely to the configured server.

label: Completed audio directory
help: Empty uses this node’s persistent audio directory. Unique filenames; no overwrite or automatic deletion.

label: Server voice
help: Default needs no reference clip. Other names must already exist on your server; this block does not upload or clone voices.

label: Completed file format
help: Ogg/Opus 48 kHz or PCM WAV 24 kHz, mono. File output only; not a live audio-stream port.

label: Served model identifier
help: Must match the Higgs model name or alias on your server. The block cannot verify the remotely loaded weight revision.

label: Trusted CA PEM file (optional)
help: Empty uses the operating system trust store. An explicit file replaces that store for this connection; certificate and hostname checks remain enabled.

label: Temperature
help: Official sampling setting. Greater values increase variation, not voice identity.

label: Top-k sampling
help: Maximum candidate tokens kept at each model sampling step.

label: Maximum generated tokens
help: A length-limited result is refused, even if audio bytes were returned. Server model/context limits also apply.

label: Maximum audio duration (seconds)
help: Reject oversized responses; never truncate them into a successful file. This is a local acceptance limit, not a server-side duration setting.

label: Maximum text characters
help: Oversized text is refused before connecting. UTF-8 also has an 8192-byte bound; inline Higgs control tags are preserved.

label: Total request deadline (seconds)
help: Includes connection, synthesis, transfer, encoding and publication after dequeue. Closing the connection does not confirm remote GPU cancellation.

label: Pending request limit
help: Active Runtime only. Zero refuses new text while busy. Interrupt cancels the local request and discards earlier pending text.
